yard.en: Tom planted three apple trees in his yard.
yard.zh: 汤姆在他的院子里种了三棵苹果树。

yacht.en: Our yacht club has ten members.
yacht.zh: 我们的游艇俱乐部里有十个会员。

yield.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
yield.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。

youth.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
youth.zh: 每次听到这首歌，都会让我回忆起自己年轻的时候。

yawn.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
yawn.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
